_notes: Schema for the full Best Bets-style form feed. One record per runner, keyed by horse name. Populate from a form provider
(racing.com / racenet / punters export) with scripts/import_form.py, or by hand. Fields marked null are rendered as '-'.

runner_fields.colours: official silks description, e.g. 'Emerald green, gold hoops, white cap'
runner_fields.silks_image: optional URL or data URI of the silks image
runner_fields.form_last12: list of run objects, most recent first
